name: Quasi-Hypertori Are Strictly Hypercellular
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every quasi-hypertorus is hypercellular, and the containment is strict.
proof: Products of edges and even cycles are cells and avoid $Q_3^-$. The path $P_3$ is median and hence hypercellular but is not a Cartesian product of the permitted factors.
